latest_release.body:
# 🚀 Release `autogpt-platform-beta-v0.11.2`

**Date:** January 2025

---

## 🔥 What's New?

### New Features
- **#16308** - Plan-first trial: starter tasks and experts on the paywall, hire step removed, team hired on trial start, Home starts with ranked tasks owned by experts (by @itsababseh)
- **#16650** - Add Wix to the MCP catalog (by @ntindle)
- **#16654** - Otto replies on the brain dump's not-enough screen (by @itsababseh)
- **#15459** - Self-serve account deletion with an optional exit question (by @itsababseh)
- **#16698** - Send a PostHog event whenever a usage limit refuses or pauses work (SECRT-3411) (by @kcze)
- **#16269** - Continue with Microsoft, with the Microsoft 365 offer as a movable onboarding step (by @ntindle)
- **#16348** - Add in-app feedback prompts (by @0ubbe)
- **#16461** - Limit how many E2B sandboxes run at once, per deployment and per account (by @Pwuts)
- **#16689** - Open a new Expert's chat from its card and the sidebar, and create and start in one click (by @itsababseh)
- **#16702** - Set the plan tier on the PostHog person (SECRT-3411) (by @kcze)
- **#15454** - Let the HubSpot blocks sign in with HubSpot OAuth (by @Bentlybro)
- **#15487** - Erase closed accounts after #15459's 14 days, keeping a ban record (erase-account CLI and job) (by @kcze)

### Enhancements
- **#16700** - Add Meta Muse Ember model support (by @ntindle)
- **#16699** - Add Claude Fable 5.2 support (by @ntindle)
- **#15761** - Overlap independent skill reads in copilot (by @ntindle)
- **#16685** - Verify OAuth client secrets off the event loop for better performance (by @ntindle)

### UI/UX Improvements
- **#16697** - Show a block's approval card in the live chat and name the Expert on Home (by @itsababseh)

### Bug Fixes
- **#16655** - Leave the model unset in generated workflows unless the user names one (by @kcze)
- **#15081** - Record why OAuth refreshes fail, stop replaying dead tokens, name missing scopes (by @Bentlybro)
- **#16216** - Delete Telegram Message no longer fails after a successful delete (by @ntindle)
- **#16621** - Normalise chat-platform messages before they are stored or run (by @ntindle)
- **#16667** - Guess CSV delimiters by parsing instead of csv.Sniffer (by @ntindle)
- **#16471** - Make brain dump ids without crypto.randomUUID (by @posthog-eu[bot])
- **#16368** - Redirect read_tool_result on workspace tool-outputs/ paths (by @0ubbe)
- **#16669** - Rebuild memory communities from one hourly job instead of a cron per scope (by @Pwuts)
- **#16691** - Remove block media files after AutoPilot block runs (by @ntindle)
- **#16690** - Bound sub-workflow nesting and count nested runs toward the user's worker share (by @ntindle)
- **#16693** - Run video encodes off the executor loop with a real time limit (by @ntindle)
- **#16692** - Honour automod_fail_open when moderation times out (by @ntindle)
- **#16672** - bash_exec kills everything a timed-out command started (by @Pwuts)
- **#16717** - Resolve a v1 external API request's auth once (by @Pwuts)
- **#16670** - The email Unsubscribe link opens a page to confirm, instead of an error (by @Pwuts)
- **#16721** - Settle a Stripe refund when an update reports it succeeded (by @Pwuts)
- **#16671** - Stop Home and onboarding bouncing after the paid onboarding checkout (by @Pwuts)
- **#16682** - Let the Discord bot see forwarded and replied-to images (by @Bentlybro)
- **#16703** - Fail at once with a clear message when an LLM request is too large for the provider (by @Bentlybro)
- **#16704** - Otto no longer says a signed-in MCP account isn't connected when the server answers 403 (by @Bentlybro)
- **#16684** - An expert run with a failed step reports failed, not completed (by @Bentlybro)
- **#16707** - Mark Exa Create Research as an external action (by @0ubbe)
- **#16713** - Treat the platform's SDK keys (Firecrawl, DataForSEO, Tavily, ...) as system credentials everywhere (by @Torantulino)
- **#16745** - Acco

detail.readme:
AutoGPT — Your team of AI Experts

Bring in specialists for content, sales, research, and recurring work.
Brief them in plain English. Let Otto coordinate.

Sign up for a trial · Watch the demo · Meet the Experts · Pricing · Self-host · Contribute

## One conversation. The right expertise. Tell Otto what's on your plate. It brings in the right Experts, hands over the work, and keeps you up to date. Talk to a specialist directly when you want to get into the details. Each Expert has a role you can shape with your instructions, context, skills, and connected apps. Start with a ready-made specialist or create your own. | Meet your team | Put them to work | | --- | --- | | **Otto · Head of AI** | Coordinate a job across specialists and bring their work back to you. | | **Maria · SEO Content Manager** | Turn a target keyword into a content brief and article draft. | | **Max · Account Executive** | Research prospects, draft outreach, and prepare the next conversation. | | **Frankie · Executive Assistant** | Prepare meeting context, email drafts, and a digest for the day. | [Explore the Experts →](https://agpt.co/experts/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=autogpt_readme&utm_content=team_experts) ## See the team at work One launch brief to Otto. Maria prepares the article, Max researches prospects, and Frankie prepares the launch review. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/83cddd83-00f8-46e7-be9e-e0a7237c7eea **[Watch the full 45-second demo →](https://agpt.co/videos/otto-team-demo-v1-1080.mp4)** · [Sign up for a trial](https://platform.agpt.co/signup?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=autogpt_readme&utm_content=demo_get_started) A 15-second highlight of a real run, edited and sped up. In this example, the team prepares the work for review without sending or publishing it. ## From a first brief to a routine 1. **Choose your Expert.** Tell Otto what you need, pick a specialist, or create one for your own way of working. 2. **Brief them on the job.** Share the context, connect the apps they need, and agree on the first outcome. 3. **Review and refine.** Check the work and adjust the instructions. Activate routines for jobs that keep coming back. You choose which accounts each Expert can access, set spending controls, and follow progress in their activity. [See how it works →](https://agpt.co/how-it-works/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=autogpt_readme&utm_content=how_it_works) ## Get started ### AutoGPT Platform Use the hosted Platform to get your team running without managing the infrastructure or supplying model API keys. **[Sign up for a trial →](https://platform.agpt.co/signup?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=autogpt_readme&utm_content=platform_get_started)** The hosted Platform is a paid service. See [current plans, trial terms, and usage pricing](https://agpt.co/pricing/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=autogpt_readme&utm_content=platform_pricing). ### Self-host AutoGPT Run AutoGPT on your own infrastructure. You provide model credentials, configure the deployment, and manage its updates and operation. The quickest way to self-host is the single-container image on Docker Hub, [`significantgravitas/autogpt`](https://hub.docker.com/r/significantgravitas/autogpt): ```bash docker run -d \ --name autogpt \ --restart unless-stopped \ --shm-size 2g \ --ulimit nofile=65536:65536 \ --log-driver json-file \ --log-opt max-size=50m \ --log-opt max-file=5 \ -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 \ -e AUTOGPT_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:3000 \ -v autogpt-data:/data \ significantgravitas/autogpt:latest ``` Give the first boot a few minutes, then open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000), create your account, and make it the administrator: ```bash docker exec autogpt autogpt-admin promote you@example.com ``` Requirements, closing signup, ports, model providers, backups, and upgrades are covered in the guide: [Read the single-container guide →](https://agpt.co/docs/platform/self-hosting/single-container) On Linux, macOS, and Windows, the [installer](https://agpt.co/docs/platform/self-hosting/installer#install) sets up the same image with one command. To run each service in its own container with Docker Compose, or to develop from source, use the [manual self-hosting guide](https://agpt.co/docs/platform/self-hosting/getting-started#manual-setup). | | Hosted Platform | Self-hosted | | --- | --- | --- | | Setup and operations | Managed by AutoGPT | Managed by you | | Model access | Built in | Bring your own model credentials or a local model | | Cost | Paid plan and usage | Your infrastructure and model usage | | Data and infrastructure | Hosted by AutoGPT | Runs on your infrastructure | See the [license](#license) for the repository's usage terms. ## Workflows when you need more control Experts can use skills and workflows to do their jobs. The visual builder lets you define repeatable steps, connect tools, and inspect how work runs. Start with a workflow from the marketplace or build your own. - **[Visual builder](https://agpt.co/product/build/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=autogpt_readme&utm_content=build):** connect blocks, branch logic, and control the steps. - **[Marketplace](https://platform.agpt.co/marketplace?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=autogpt_readme&utm_content=marketplace):** discover workflows you can adapt to your work. - **[Integrations](https://agpt.co/docs/integrations):** connect the tools your team uses. - **[API and MCP server](https://agpt.co/docs/platform/api-and-integrations/api-guide):** run and build workflows from your own code, or from an AI coding agent. ## Build with us Explore the code, report a problem, or help improve AutoGPT. | Resource | Where to go | | --- | --- | | Platform source and development setup | [autogpt_platform/](autogpt_platform/README.md) | | Documentation | [agpt.co/docs](https://agpt.co/docs) | | Contributing | [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) | | Bugs and feature requests | [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT/issues/new/choose) | | Community and support | [Discord](https://discord.gg/autogpt) | ## License | Component | License | What it means | |---|---|---| | `autogpt_platform/` | [Polyform Shield](https://polyformproject.org/licenses/shield/1.0.0) | Free for personal and internal business use; cannot be sold as a competing hosted service | | `classic/` and everything else | [MIT](LICENSE) | Permissive open-source use | --- ## AutoGPT Classic Looking for the original standalone AutoGPT? Explore [Classic](classic/README.md), [Forge](classic/forge/README.md), or [agbenchmark](https://pypi.org/project/agbenchmark/). ## Contributors
